newsitem.title: USA: Teledata prices 2.76 mln shares at $26.
newsitem.headline: Teledata prices 2.76 mln shares at $26.

text.p: Teledata Communications Ltd said Tuesday its public offering of 2.76 million shares was priced at $26 a share by the managing underwriters Smith Barney Inc and Oppenheimer & Co Inc as co-leaders, Cowen & Co and Robertson Stephens & Co LLC.
It said 1.1 million shares are being offered by the company and the rest are being offered by certain shareholders.
The company has granted the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to 414,000 additional shares to cover over-allotments.
Net proceeds to the company will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes.
